_comment: 27B-class geometry (qwen3_5_27b preset: hidden 5120, 64 layers, FFN 17408) on a 2 nm-class die with one HBM4 stack per layer ASIC: eight layer ASICs of eight layers (two R,R,R,G groups each, so global_every is 4) (2.86B coefficients, about 76 mm2 of fabric at a tenth of the 28 nm-class density). Fabric at 2.5 GHz (extrapolated): 4 passes x 2560 cycles = 4.1 us per layer, 1.0 us per head die; global compute phases scaled by the clock ratio from the 3 nm configuration. int4 KV at 16:1 compression, 2 TB/s per die, 256 resident contexts, a 16 GB/s ring link, 0.35 pJ per MAC, 25 pJ per byte for HBM4 and 250 W static. Pass-level pipelining is not modeled, so a layer stage still admits one token per layer latency.
